prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: an independent transparent Chinese title-lettering layer for an original anime game.
Input image 1 is the existing logo reference, not a background to keep. Redraw its Chinese words as a noticeably better crafted bespoke hand-lettered logotype. Preserve recognisable blue-and-white hand-written character and the two-line reading order; make the stroke design more assured, compact, balanced and beautifully polished. The existing small English sentence and all stars must be absent because they will be separate layers.

TEXT MUST BE EXACTLY THESE EIGHT SIMPLIFIED CHINESE CHARACTERS:
Top line: 升格会的
Bottom line: 冬日猜想
Spell and draw each accurately: 升 / 格 / 会 / 的 / 冬 / 日 / 猜 / 想. No duplicated, omitted, invented or traditional characters.

Art direction: expert original Chinese lettering for a premium hand-drawn anime game, cool winter mystery and quiet confidence, with a little sharp futuristic precision in the terminals. Heavy, lively brush-built silhouettes; well-judged curves and restrained angular wedge terminals. Full clean ink coverage, clearly shaped counters, economical broad shapes rather than many tiny marks. Slight expressive slant and very subtle shared baseline rhythm, never chaotic. Make the top and bottom lines fit together into one satisfying compact silhouette; the character 的 may be slightly smaller but plainly readable. Maintain legibility when the whole Chinese mark is displayed only 270 px wide. Avoid a default printed font, generic mechanical stencil, fluffy children's cartoon lettering or aggressive metal lettering.

Palette: opaque deep blue ink around #263D70 and controlled cobalt #4F73B6, with a narrow crisp ivory-white keyline. Very limited flat interior highlight shapes, no material noise. A clean sharp silhouette, NOT the reference's fuzzy outer border. No blurred glow, baked drop shadow, 3D extrusion, chrome, heavy gradient, sparkle inside letters or ornamental cuts that break readability.

Composition: only the two-line Chinese wordmark, centered, isolated, with tightly controlled transparent margins of roughly 8 percent; the letter block occupies most of the canvas and is wide enough for four characters per line. Flat front view. Export actual transparent alpha, never a checkerboard or a painted background.
No English, no Latin letters, no extra words, no stars, no constellation lines, no snowflakes, no scenery, no frame, no character, no watermark, no mockup.
